{
 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Prediction (out of sample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 1,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:09.433921Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:09.433724Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:11.371684Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:11.367233Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "%matplotlib inline"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:11.380177Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:11.379830Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.427055Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.426467Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "import statsmodels.api as sm\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.rc(\"figure\", figsize=(16, 8))\n",
    "plt.rc(\"font\", size=14)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Artificial data"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.433088Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.432704Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.443269Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.442806Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "nsample = 50\n",
    "sig = 0.25\n",
    "x1 = np.linspace(0, 20, nsample)\n",
    "X = np.column_stack((x1, np.sin(x1), (x1 - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "X = sm.add_constant(X)\n",
    "beta = [5.0, 0.5, 0.5, -0.02]\n",
    "y_true = np.dot(X, beta)\n",
    "y = y_true + sig * np.random.normal(size=nsample)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Estimation "
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.446370Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.445635Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.485573Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.484196Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "                            OLS Regression Results                            \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Dep. Variable:                      y   R-squared:                       0.982\n",
      "Model:                            OLS   Adj. R-squared:                  0.981\n",
      "Method:                 Least Squares   F-statistic:                     859.5\n",
      "Date:                Sat, 24 Oct 2026   Prob (F-statistic):           2.19e-40\n",
      "Time:                        18:38:16   Log-Likelihood:               -0.47334\n",
      "No. Observations:                  50   AIC:                             8.947\n",
      "Df Residuals:                      46   BIC:                             16.59\n",
      "Df Model:                           3                                         \n",
      "Covariance Type:            nonrobust                                         \n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "                 coef    std err          t      P>|t|      [0.025      0.975]\n",
      "------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "const          4.9217      0.087     56.700      0.000       4.747       5.096\n",
      "x1             0.5124      0.013     38.276      0.000       0.485       0.539\n",
      "x2             0.4840      0.053      9.197      0.000       0.378       0.590\n",
      "x3            -0.0219      0.001    -18.594      0.000      -0.024      -0.019\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "Omnibus:                        0.445   Durbin-Watson:                   2.421\n",
      "Prob(Omnibus):                  0.800   Jarque-Bera (JB):                0.380\n",
      "Skew:                          -0.202   Prob(JB):                        0.827\n",
      "Kurtosis:                       2.858   Cond. No.                         221.\n",
      "==============================================================================\n",
      "\n",
      "Notes:\n",
      "[1] Standard Errors assume that the covariance matrix of the errors is correctly specified.\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "olsmod = sm.OLS(y, X)\n",
    "olsres = olsmod.fit()\n",
    "print(olsres.summary())"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## In-sample prediction"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.494880Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.494664Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.511061Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.510444Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[ 4.37530425  4.86214002  5.31012853  5.69289078  5.99356783  6.20759063\n",
      "  6.34343075  6.42120851  6.46938724  6.52009688  6.60385509  6.7445533\n",
      "  6.95553142  7.2373861   7.57787274  7.95391722  8.33540692  8.69013815\n",
      "  8.9891071   9.2112751   9.3470252   9.39974225  9.38525671  9.3292438\n",
      "  9.26300515  9.21832595  9.22225283  9.29265011  9.43526476  9.64278221\n",
      "  9.89602808 10.1671185  10.42404134 10.63591571 10.77806562 10.83607416\n",
      " 10.80815215 10.70543212 10.55013926 10.37193986 10.20306726 10.07302597\n",
      " 10.0037442  10.00597107 10.07751059 10.20358247 10.35925044 10.51351922\n",
      " 10.634427   10.69429661]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "ypred = olsres.predict(X)\n",
    "print(ypred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Create a new sample of explanatory variables Xnew, predict and plot"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.512940Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.512747Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.522914Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.522454Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "[10.65780496 10.49225466 10.21662737  9.87417993  9.52185355  9.21633262\n",
      "  9.0001664   8.89135148  8.87892557  8.92565147]\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "x1n = np.linspace(20.5, 25, 10)\n",
    "Xnew = np.column_stack((x1n, np.sin(x1n), (x1n - 5) ** 2))\n",
    "Xnew = sm.add_constant(Xnew)\n",
    "ynewpred = olsres.predict(Xnew)  # predict out of sample\n",
    "print(ynewpred)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Plot comparison"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.525343Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:16.525144Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.170709Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.170092Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "<matplotlib.legend.Legend at 0x7758d174a7b0>"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 7,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    },
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1600x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots()\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y, \"o\", label=\"Data\")\n",
    "ax.plot(x1, y_true, \"b-\", label=\"True\")\n",
    "ax.plot(np.hstack((x1, x1n)), np.hstack((ypred, ynewpred)), \"r\", label=\"OLS prediction\")\n",
    "ax.legend(loc=\"best\")"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Predicting with Formulas"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Using formulas can make both estimation and prediction a lot easier"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.177056Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.176823Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.201551Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.200122Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "from statsmodels.formula.api import ols\n",
    "\n",
    "data = {\"x1\": x1, \"y\": y}\n",
    "\n",
    "res = ols(\"y ~ x1 + np.sin(x1) + I((x1-5)**2)\", data=data).fit()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We use the `I` to indicate use of the Identity transform. Ie., we do not want any expansion magic from using `**2`"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.203648Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.203387Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.220459Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.219817Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "Intercept           4.921698\n",
       "x1                  0.512413\n",
       "np.sin(x1)          0.484026\n",
       "I((x1 - 5) ** 2)   -0.021856\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 9,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.params"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Now we only have to pass the single variable and we get the transformed right-hand side variables automatically"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 10,
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.222739Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.222532Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.239186Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-10-24T18:38:17.237376Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "text/plain": [
       "0    10.657805\n",
       "1    10.492255\n",
       "2    10.216627\n",
       "3     9.874180\n",
       "4     9.521854\n",
       "5     9.216333\n",
       "6     9.000166\n",
       "7     8.891351\n",
       "8     8.878926\n",
       "9     8.925651\n",
       "dtype: float64"
      ]
     },
     "execution_count": 10,
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "execute_result"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "res.predict(exog=dict(x1=x1n))"
   ]
  }
 ],
